Column height basis: to_slab_soffit (configurable in Settings).

Slabs measured over beams (gross zone area less shafts/openings); beams measured below the slab to avoid double counting.
Footing and column volumes use the drawn geometry; schedule sizes are used as an independent cross-check.
Blinding thickness 100 mm from drawing note (9 occurrences on S-FD.dxf).
Tie-beam depth = largest vertical dimension on the 'TYPICAL SECTION THROUGH T.B.n' detail; width from the plan.
Pedestal size note '500X500X500 MM' interpreted as length x width x height.
RC wall height = storey height of the floor; door/window openings in walls are not deducted.
Slab IDs, raft IDs and residual-zone IDs are system-generated - the drawings do not number them.

settings_used._comment: Default engine settings. Per-project user overrides are stored in data/projects/<id>/overrides.json and every change is written to the audit log.

measurement._column_height_basis_options: to_slab_soffit = level(top) - level(base) - slab thickness at top; floor_to_floor = level(top) - level(base)
measurement._beam_depth_basis_options: below_slab = deduct slab thickness from overall depth where the family's depth includes the slab; full_depth = no deduction
